title: Alerting when calibration results in a significant slope/intercept shift
symptom: A calibration can result in a significant slope shift, which may be undesirable and unnoticed, leading to xDrip interpreting glucose levels 1-2 mmol/L higher than actual. The user requests a toast or alert with sound to warn when calibration slope or intercept changes significantly.
evidence_quote: I am converting this to a discussion. It will still be found through search. A developer could still see it and decide to implement it.
